items: New: "What's new" — the app now tells you what changed in each update, before and after you install it
Find it any time in Settings → What's new
Fixed: Copy said "Could not copy" — copying a message now works
Fixed: the message popup could close itself before you saw it
"Show test popup" now tells you if the popup could not be shown
The popup log now says why a popup was closed
Sturdier message popup: it appears on the screen you are working on
If the popup cannot be shown, a system notification is used instead
New "Popup log" button in Popup settings
Fixed scrolling in long chats: older messages load as you scroll up
A button to jump to the newest message
Sturdier file downloads
Typing indicator
Cancel a download
Zoom in on pictures and screenshots
Fixed: messages flickering under the mouse
Drag and drop files straight onto a chat in the list
Right-click menu on messages: reply, copy, forward, pin, star, select
Edit a sent message
Group admins and a member limit
Emoji reactions
Delete for everyone and delete for me
@mentions in groups
Update notice above the search box
